div.span:
• Centralized Request Handler: Single entry point intercepting all incoming HTTP/web requests
• Filter & Middleware Chains: Applies authentication, authorization, CORS, and request logging
• Command Dispatching: Resolves and delegates to dedicated command handlers or actions
• Modern Manifestations: Spring DispatcherServlet, Express routers, Next.js routing middleware

div.span:
• Screen Flow Decoupling: Extracts multi-step wizard and navigation logic out of UI view files
• State Machine Coordinator: Manages business steps (Cart → Shipping → Payment → Confirm)
• Dynamic View Target Resolution: Selects next view based on application state and domain results
• View-Model Assembly: Prepares presentation-ready models before handing off to the view layer

div.span:
• Template View (Component SSR): Embeds markers in static markup (Astro, React JSX, ERB, JSP)
• Transform View (Data Projections): Transforms domain representations into wire payloads or JSON-LD
• Zero Domain Leakage: View layer contains zero database queries, SQL strings, or business rules
• Deterministic Output: Pure rendering function consuming immutable view models

• Latency penalty (100,000x)

Coarse interfaces only;
keep entity graphs local.

div.span:
• Anti-Chatty Network Boundary: Consolidates dozens of fine-grained domain calls into single round trips
• Coarse-Grained Protocol Contract: Optimized wire interface (REST / gRPC / GraphQL endpoints)
• Bulk Transaction Boundary: Initiates and commits application transactions across remote sessions
• Context Translation: Bridges client authentication and tenant headers into internal domain context

div.span:
• Flat, Serializable Payloads: Dumb data carriers designed exclusively for wire serialization
• Zero Business Logic: Contains getters/setters or raw values with zero domain behavioral methods
• Cycle-Free Structures: Eliminates complex recursive object graph pointers (order.customer.order...)
• Versioning & Schema Shield: Protects internal database and entity schemas from leaking across APIs

div.span:
• Rich Aggregate Roots & Entities: Encapsulate business invariants, validations, and state machines
• Fine-Grained Behavioral Methods: Traverses cyclic in-memory references (order.applyDiscount())
• Zero Wire Knowledge: Domain model remains completely pure, with no knowledge of HTTP, DTOs, or RPC
• Assembler / Mapper Isolation: Transforms between flat DTOs and rich entities at the boundary
